correctness.rationale: A complete fixed-sum linearity-and-triangle proof covers all n>=3, including repeated-part triangles. The sum identities eliminate two simultaneous extensions, yielding size<=4 for every nontrivial intersecting family. Explicit witnesses attain four at all n>=8. Unordered positive pair counting gives full-star sizes. Direct complete listing resolves n=3..8; maximal-clique enumeration independently cross-checks n=3..20 and witnesses through n=100. Finite checks are supporting, not an infinite proof.
